strings.body: An old link hops from http to https, then to www, then to a trailing slash. Every hop costs a round trip, and crawlers can stop following a long chain before they reach the page.
strings.visual.note: Labelled example: three hops to reach one page
strings.action: Follow your old links to their final address. Send each one there in a single redirect, and update the links you control.

strings.body: Images without dimensions, late ads and swapped fonts push content down while people read and tap. Cumulative Layout Shift measures it, and 0.1 or less counts as good.
strings.visual.note: Width and height let the browser reserve the space
strings.action: Load your page on a slow connection and watch it settle. Give images a width and height, and reserve space for ads and embeds.
